title: Guard PLU Simplified Modification 2: Public Access
text:
La Garde PLU Update Aims to Align with Nouvelle Provence Côte d’Aur Line Expansion
A revised local urban plan for the town of La Garde, France, is now open for public review, focusing on adapting regulations to accommodate the evolving Nouvelle Provence Côte d’Aur Line (LNPCA) in the La pauline sector. The changes, formalized by the Metropolitan Council on september 24, 2025, through deliberation no. 25/09/217, seek to ensure the town’s planning aligns with the regional transportation network.
Public Access to Proposed Modifications
Residents will have the possibility to examine the proposed simplified modification no. 2 of the Guard PLU, along with supporting documentation, at the La Garde Town Hall, located at rue Jean Baptiste Lavène, 83130 La Garde. The files will be available for inspection Monday through Friday, from 8:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.and from 1:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m., beginning October 13, 2025, and continuing through November 17, 2025.
According to a statement released by the Metropolitan Council, the publicly available materials will include the proposed modification itself, a detailed statement of reasons outlining the rationale for the changes, and any opinions issued by Associated Public Persons as outlined in articles L132-7 and L132-9 of the Urban Planning Code. A register will also be available for citizens to record their observations and suggestions.
opportunities for Public Input
The public is encouraged to provide feedback on the proposed changes through several avenues. Individuals can submit written comments to the President of the Toulon Provence Méditerranée Metropolis at the La Garde Town Hall address. Alternatively, electronic submissions are accepted via email at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) until 5:30 p.m. on November 17, 2025.
A senior official stated that all submissions should clearly indicate “Simplified modification no.2 of the Guard PLU” in the email subject line. This streamlined process aims to facilitate a clear and inclusive dialogue regarding the future development of La Garde, particularly in relation to the expanding regional rail network.
The move underscores a broader trend of municipalities adapting local planning regulations to support and integrate with larger-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring enduring and coordinated growth.
News Report Expansion:
La Garde Adapts Planning for New Rail Line: Public Review Underway
La Garde, france – The town of La Garde is undergoing a planning update to accommodate the expansion of the Nouvelle Provence Côte d’Aur Line (LNPCA), a regional rail project. the Metropolitan Council approved the proposed changes, designated “Simplified modification no.2 of the Guard PLU,” on September 24, 2025, through deliberation no. 25/09/217.
Why is this happening? The update aims to align local regulations with the LNPCA’s development in the La Pauline sector, ensuring coordinated growth and maximizing the benefits of the new transportation infrastructure. The changes will address land use, building regulations, and possibly environmental considerations near the rail line.
Who is involved? The Toulon Provence Méditerranée Metropolis is leading the initiative, with the Metropolitan Council formally approving the modifications.Residents of La Garde, along with “Associated Public Persons” as defined by French Urban Planning Code, have a direct opportunity to provide input.
